systemOverview.purpose: Provides centralized, auditable administration of pension schemes, employer contributions, member enrollment, accounts, investments, and benefit disbursements.
systemOverview.architecturalRationale: A modular monolith ensures strict transactional consistency for financial reconciliation and contribution ledgering while avoiding the operational latency and distributed transaction overhead of microservices. It allows clear modular boundaries that can be split into separate services if organizational scaling demands it.
systemOverview.description: EPAS orchestrates pension lifecycle management from scheme rule configuration and employer-member associations to multi-tier financial reconciliations, investment tracking, and segregated benefit approval workflows. The architecture mandates immutable audit logging and strict role-based separation of duties across all transactional touchpoints.

actors.name: Pension Administrator
actors.responsibility: Configures pension schemes, maintains eligibility rules, associates employers, manages member records, and administers pension accounts.
interactions: Create and update schemes and eligibility rules
Register and manage employers and scheme associations
Oversee member registrations, account creations, and duplicate resolutions

actors.name: Finance Personnel
actors.responsibility: Oversees financial integrity, records contribution receipts, triggers allocations, and performs balance reconciliation.
interactions: Record and verify contribution receipts against bank settlements
Execute and review member contribution allocations
Run reconciliation jobs, identify discrepancies, and preserve financial evidence

actors.name: Operations Personnel
actors.responsibility: Handles day-to-day transaction processing, ingestion of employer contribution schedules, and operational exception tracking.
interactions: Monitor transaction pipelines and resolve operational exceptions

actors.name: Benefit Approver
actors.responsibility: Provides independent governance and dual-authorization on member benefit claims, upholding separation of duties.
interactions: Approve or reject benefit payout requests with decision rationales

actors.name: Member
actors.responsibility: Enrolls into permitted schemes, reviews pension accounts, and requests benefit payments.
interactions: View account balances and investment holdings

actors.name: Compliance / Auditor
actors.responsibility: Inspects system-wide audit trails, reviews material changes, and ensures regulatory compliance.
interactions: Query historical audit records and change logs
Generate discrepancy, exception, and regulatory compliance reports

actors.name: System Scheduler
actors.responsibility: Executes background batch processing for automated reconciliation and scheduled reporting.

components.name: API Gateway & Security Filter
components.responsibility: Terminates TLS, validates JWT tokens, enforces rate limiting, and performs initial payload structure validation.
components.whyItExists: Protects internal modules from unauthorized access and centralizes edge cross-cutting concerns.

components.name: Scheme & Rule Management Module
components.responsibility: Maintains pension schemes, lifecycle statuses, and dynamic eligibility evaluation rules.
components.whyItExists: Decouples scheme rules and legal parameters from transactional member processing.

components.name: Employer Management Module
components.responsibility: Registers participating corporate employers, tracks primary contacts, and manages scheme participation links.
components.whyItExists: Serves as the master record for contributing corporate entities.

components.name: Member & Enrollment Module
components.responsibility: Manages member demographics, enforces anti-duplicate registration rules, and processes scheme enrollments.
components.whyItExists: Guarantees demographic data cleanliness and gates scheme enrollment against configured rules.

components.name: Pension Account Module
components.responsibility: Maintains pension account records linking members to active schemes with unique ledger accounts.
components.whyItExists: Acts as the anchor entity for balances, allocations, and investments.

components.name: Contribution & Reconciliation Engine
components.responsibility: Ingests contribution schedules, records receipts, runs member allocations, and balances three-way reconciliations.
components.whyItExists: Ensures full fiduciary control and prevents unallocated or unmatched cash flows.

components.name: Investment Management Module
components.responsibility: Records member fund allocations across approved investment products and tracks asset value updates.
components.whyItExists: Tracks portfolio allocations and provides auditability for investment balance modifications.

components.name: Benefit Processing Module
components.responsibility: Validates benefit claims, handles dual-control approval state machines, and records disbursement outcomes.
components.whyItExists: Enforces segregation of duties and fraud prevention during pension drawdowns.

components.name: Audit & Compliance Service
components.responsibility: Captures immutable before/after snapshots of material changes and exposes audit query interfaces.
components.whyItExists: Fulfills statutory pension compliance for non-repudiation and traceability.

components.name: Reporting & Analytics Service
components.responsibility: Compiles operational dashboard states, reconciliation discrepancy summaries, and financial reports.
components.whyItExists: Offloads reporting load from core transactional write paths using optimized read projections.

communicationPatterns: Synchronous REST/JSON over HTTPS via API Gateway for interactive client transactions and queries
Synchronous in-process transactional method calls across modules within boundary transaction contexts
Asynchronous domain event dispatch via internal transaction-bound Application Event Bus for audit logging and cache invalidation

functionalModules.name: Scheme Configuration & Rule Administration
functionalModules.purpose: Manages pension scheme entities, parameters, validity windows, and associated enrollment eligibility rules.
responsibilities: Persist and update pension schemes with status and validity dates
Configure and store dynamic eligibility rules per scheme
Capture material audit logs on rule or scheme modifications

functionalModules.purpose: Governs participating employers, maintains their authorized communication channels, and associates them to schemes.
responsibilities: Register unique employer records and lookup profiles
Maintain authorized corporate contact details
Bind employers to eligible pension schemes with effective dating

functionalModules.name: Member Registration & Enrollment Management
functionalModules.purpose: Registers prospective members, detects duplicates, quarantines anomalous inputs, and evaluates enrollment eligibility.
responsibilities: Create member profiles and enforce National Insurance Number uniqueness
Quarantine duplicate or suspect member registrations with reason codes
Evaluate member demographics against scheme rules before confirming enrollment

functionalModules.name: Pension Account Administration
functionalModules.purpose: Maintains ledger account containers for enrolled members linked to schemes.
responsibilities: Provision unique pension account identifiers upon successful enrollment
Maintain account status lifecycle and traceability to members and schemes

functionalModules.name: Contribution & Financial Reconciliation
functionalModules.purpose: Handles contribution submission schedules, receipts, allocations, exceptions, and three-way reconciliation balances.
responsibilities: Record employer contribution submissions with financial references
Record bank receipts matching submissions
Allocate amounts across individual member pension accounts
Calculate reconciliations across submitted, received, and allocated funds
Trap discrepancies and unallocated amounts into tracked exception states
Preserve tamper-proof financial action evidence

functionalModules.name: Investment Governance
functionalModules.purpose: Maintains member investment product assignments, balances, and history of investment adjustments.
responsibilities: Create and maintain investment allocations per member and scheme
Record audited change history for investment movements

functionalModules.name: Benefit Adjudication & Approval
functionalModules.purpose: Validates member benefit applications, enforces separation of duties via approver workflows, and logs disbursement states.
responsibilities: Validate benefit claims against scheme drawdown criteria
Enforce dual-control approvals preventing submitter self-approval
Record formal approval or rejection decisions and payment statuses

functionalModules.name: Operational & Compliance Reporting
functionalModules.purpose: Provides operational dashboards, audit logs, and exception and reconciliation discrepancy reports.
responsibilities: Generate periodic financial and operational status reports
Provide near-real-time processing visibility dashboards
Expose reconciliation variances and unresolved exception queries
Provide immutable, queryable audit review logs for regulatory audits

businessFlows.name: Member Registration and Scheme Enrollment
steps: Administrator submits member demographics (NIN, name, DOB) via UI/API.
Member & Enrollment Module verifies National Insurance Number against existing Member records.
If duplicate or inconsistent record found, Member is saved with status 'QUARANTINED' and quarantine_reason, aborting enrollment.
If clear, Member is created with status 'ACTIVE'.
Enrollment request submitted for target Scheme.
Module fetches active EligibilityRules for Scheme and validates Member attributes (e.g., minimum age).
Upon successful validation, creates Enrollment record with status 'CONFIRMED' and eligibility_result 'PASSED'.
Pension Account Module creates a new linked PensionAccount in status 'OPEN' and emits an audit event.
validations: Member age against scheme EligibilityRule definition
businessFlows.result: Member is registered, verified eligible, enrolled in the scheme, and allocated an active pension account.

businessFlows.name: Contribution Ingestion, Allocation, and Reconciliation
steps: Employer contribution schedule received and recorded as ContributionSubmission with total amount and reference.
Bank deposit verified and recorded as ContributionReceipt linked to the submission.
Finance executes allocation batch distributing receipt amount across member PensionAccounts as ContributionAllocation records.
System validates that sum of ContributionAllocations matches ContributionReceipt amount.
Reconciliation engine aggregates submissions, receipts, and allocations for the scheme period.
If all amounts match exactly, a ReconciliationRecord is persisted with status 'BALANCED'.
If amounts mismatch, ReconciliationRecord is marked 'DISCREPANCY_FLAGGED', and an operational exception alert is emitted.
Material financial action snapshot is written to AuditTrail.
businessFlows.result: Contribution money is received, allocated to member accounts, and reconciled with discrepancies surfaced immediately.

businessFlows.name: Benefit Request Validation and Dual-Control Approval
steps: Operations or Member submits a BenefitRequest specifying benefit_type and requested_amount.
Benefit Processing Module validates available balance on member PensionAccount and verifies scheme retirement rules.
If validation passes, BenefitRequest is persisted with status 'PENDING_APPROVAL'.
Independent Benefit Approver reviews the claim via dashboard.
System asserts Approver actor_id is strictly different from the submitter actor_id (enforcing separation of duties).
Approver records 'APPROVED' decision with notes, generating a BenefitApproval record.
BenefitRequest status transitions to 'APPROVED' with approved_at timestamp.
AuditTrail records the state change, approver identity, and decision rationale.
businessFlows.result: Benefit request is verified, approved under dual authorization, and marked ready for disbursement.

dataFlows.name: Member Registration & Account Creation Data Flow
steps: Client sends registration payload to API Gateway.
API Gateway validates JWT and forwards to Member & Enrollment Module.
Member Module queries Member table for duplicate NIN checks.
Member record persisted to database.
Module requests eligibility evaluation from Scheme Module.
Enrollment record persisted with validation outcome.
Pension Account Module creates PensionAccount row.
Synchronous transaction commits across Member, Enrollment, and PensionAccount tables.
Asynchronous audit payload dispatched to Audit Service.
dataFlows.consistency: Strong Consistency within ACID transaction boundary across Member, Enrollment, and Account.

dataFlows.name: Financial Contribution and Ledger Allocation Flow
steps: Operations uploads submission metadata to Contribution Engine.
Finance posts verified bank settlement receipt.
Batch allocation distributes amounts to member accounts within a transactional unit of work.
Sum check performed comparing sum(allocations) against receipt amount.
Reconciliation calculation executed comparing ledger sums.
ReconciliationRecord committed.
Material financial action evidence committed to AuditTrail.
dataFlows.consistency: Strong consistency enforced by database transaction locks to guarantee zero allocation leaks.

transactions: Enrollment & Account Creation: Encompasses Member status check, Enrollment insertion, and PensionAccount provisioning within a single atomic commit.
Contribution Allocation: Batch INSERT into ContributionAllocation wrapped with a verification check ensuring sum(allocations) <= ContributionReceipt.amount.
Benefit Decision: Atomic execution updating BenefitRequest status and inserting BenefitApproval and AuditTrail entries.
integrityConstraints: Composite unique constraint on EmployerSchemeAssociation (employer_id, scheme_id, effective_date)
Foreign key constraints on all child entity links with ON DELETE RESTRICT to avoid accidental data loss
Check constraints ensuring all monetary amounts (amount, requested_amount) are >= 0
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_member_nin ON Member(national_insurance_number)
CREATE INDEX idx_enrollment_member_scheme ON Enrollment(member_id, scheme_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_contrib_sub_employer_scheme ON ContributionSubmission(employer_id, scheme_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_reconciliation_scheme_period ON ReconciliationRecord(scheme_id, period_start, period_end)
CREATE INDEX idx_audit_entity ON AuditTrail(entity_type, entity_id, changed_at)

security.authentication: OpenID Connect (OIDC) / OAuth2 with JSON Web Tokens (JWT) signed using RS256. Every API call validates token signature, expiration, and issuer against an enterprise identity provider.
security.authorization: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) augmented with Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) for data boundaries. Enforces explicit separation of duties (e.g., Benefit submitters cannot approve claims).
roles: PENSION_ADMIN: Manage schemes, rules, employers, and member profiles.
FINANCE: Manage receipts, allocations, reconciliations, and financial evidence.
OPERATIONS: Upload submissions, resolve exceptions, initiate benefit claims.
BENEFIT_APPROVER: Independent authority to approve or reject benefit claims.
MEMBER: View personal account details, request benefits, initiate self-enrollment.
COMPLIANCE: Read-only access to audit trails, discrepancy reports, and operational logs.
security.credentialProtection: Enterprise identity federation via SAML/OIDC; internal service-to-service communication authenticated using mTLS and rotated API credentials stored in a hardware security module or managed secrets store.
security.tokenManagement: Short-lived access tokens (15-minute lifespan) paired with cryptographically secure, rotating refresh tokens revoked immediately upon session invalidation.
apiSecurity: OWASP Top 10 mitigation via API Gateway filters
Strict JSON payload schema validation before routing
Rate limiting per IP and client API key
dataProtection: Encryption at rest using AES-256 for all persistent storage volumes and database tablespaces
Column-level encryption for sensitive PII (e.g., national_insurance_number)
TLS 1.3 enforced for all data in transit
Immutable append-only tables for AuditTrail records preventing modification or deletion

errorHandling.detection: Database unique constraint violation on national_insurance_number or duplicate demographic matching heuristic.
errorHandling.response: HTTP 409 Conflict returned with structured payload indicating identity quarantine status.
errorHandling.recovery: Member record is persisted in 'QUARANTINED' status with reason code; alert dispatched for administrative review without blocking unrelated registrations.

errorHandling.detection: Reconciliation calculation detects submitted_amount != received_amount or received_amount != allocated_amount.
errorHandling.response: Reconciliation calculation sets status to 'DISCREPANCY_FLAGGED' and returns HTTP 200 with variance breakdown.
errorHandling.recovery: System flags variance, generates an operational exception entry, and notifies Finance for manual adjustment without silently discarding imbalances.

errorHandling.detection: Approver actor_id matches the submitter actor_id during benefit approval evaluation.
errorHandling.recovery: Approval transaction is rejected and rolled back; security audit event is logged.

errorHandling.detection: Eligibility evaluation fails dynamic rule assertions (e.g., age or employment status).
errorHandling.response: HTTP 400 Bad Request with detailed evaluation results indicating failed rule clauses.
errorHandling.recovery: Enrollment record marked 'REJECTED'; member is notified of ineligibility reason; no account is provisioned.

errorHandling.detection: Optimistic locking exception or database deadlock during allocation write batch.
errorHandling.response: HTTP 409 Conflict or 503 Service Unavailable with Retry-After header.
errorHandling.recovery: Engine employs exponential backoff retry up to 3 times before failing the batch and rolling back allocation state.

Database read-write splitting with dedicated read replicas for compliance and operational queries
Asynchronous background workers handling heavy batch reconciliations without blocking user requests
availability: Multi-Availability Zone (Multi-AZ) deployment targeting 99.95% operational uptime
Automated health checks and self-healing containerized application runtimes
Database automated multi-AZ failover with near-zero recovery point objective (RPO < 1 min)
reliability: ACID transactions for all financial movements ensuring zero balance leakage
Idempotency keys enforced on all financial submission and payment endpoints
Daily automated database backups with point-in-time recovery (PITR) retained for 30 days
maintainability: Clear domain boundaries implemented as isolated Java/Kotlin or .NET packages within a modular monolith
Comprehensive Open API 3.0 (Swagger) specifications generated for all REST interfaces
Automated CI/CD pipelines enforcing static code analysis, security scanning, and unit test coverage >= 85%
observability: Structured JSON logging enriched with correlation IDs across all layer boundaries
Prometheus-compatible metrics tracking transaction rates, allocation latencies, and discrepancy counts
OpenTelemetry distributed tracing instrumenting request paths through API Gateway to persistence layer
Centralized Grafana dashboards for financial reconciliations, exceptions, and system health

architecturalDecisions.decision: Adopt a Modular Monolith architecture rather than distributed Microservices.
architecturalDecisions.rationale: Pension calculations and ledger reconciliation require strong ACID guarantees across schemes, allocations, and accounts. Distributed transactions would introduce unwarranted latency, partial failure complexity, and eventual consistency risks.
architecturalDecisions.consequence: All modules share a single transactional relational database while enforcing compile-time packaging barriers to maintain clean boundaries.

architecturalDecisions.decision: Implement Quarantine Pattern on Member Registration duplicates rather than outright silent drops or hard exceptions.
architecturalDecisions.rationale: SCRUM-43 requires duplicate and invalid registrations to be flagged and retained for manual administrative resolution. Quarantining preserves registration context and enables compliance investigation.
architecturalDecisions.consequence: The Member entity must support nullable quarantine reason states and gate subsequent enrollment checks on a non-quarantined status.

architecturalDecisions.decision: Enforce strict Segregation of Duties (Dual-Control) in the Benefit Approval engine.
architecturalDecisions.rationale: Pension drawdown operations present high fiduciary and fraud risk; the submitter of a claim must never be allowed to approve their own request.
architecturalDecisions.consequence: The Benefit Approval API validates and rejects transactions where the authenticated actor equals the requester, necessitating separate operator and approver identities.

architecturalDecisions.decision: Implement an append-only AuditTrail entity utilizing JSONB payload diffing.
architecturalDecisions.rationale: Regulatory compliance across scheme modifications, investment switches, and financial transactions mandates tamper-evident change histories.
architecturalDecisions.consequence: Slight increase in database storage requirements, offset by rich point-in-time reconstructability for regulatory audits.

implementationSequence: Phase 1: Foundation & Persistence - Provision relational database schema (DDL, primary keys, foreign keys, unique constraints, and indexes) adhering strictly to the ERD.
Phase 2: Security & Cross-Cutting Infrastructure - Configure OAuth2/OIDC JWT authentication filter, RBAC authorization handlers, and the immutable AuditTrail persistence service.
Phase 3: Master Data Modules - Build Scheme Configuration, Eligibility Rules, and Employer Management modules with REST endpoints and audit listeners.
Phase 4: Member & Account Core - Implement Member registration with duplicate/quarantine checks, dynamic eligibility validation engine, and Pension Account creation.
Phase 5: Financial Contribution Pipeline - Implement Contribution Submission recording, Receipt matching, and atomic batch Member Allocation engine.
Phase 6: Financial Reconciliation Engine - Build three-way reconciliation logic, discrepancy detection mechanisms, and exception tracking workflows.
Phase 7: Investments & Benefits Workflow - Develop Investment product management and Benefit claim state machine with dual-control approval enforcement.
Phase 8: Reporting, Compliance & Observability - Implement operational status dashboards, reconciliation discrepancy reporting, OpenTelemetry tracing, and metric alerts.
Phase 9: End-to-End Testing & Production Deployment - Execute automated integration tests, penetration testing, reconciliation stress tests, and rollout to high-availability multi-AZ infrastructure.
